description: Hand-written toolbox row 1 composition answers: a status row is keyed by its holder (a body, or since row G3 an NPC or item) and status target, keeps one generation while active, never shortens its end, and tombstones inactive; a permanent row (row W8) is its generation alone and never changes kind while active. An active row's end and tick are checked against the composing time: the due time of the last completed job, else the horizon (Beads loka-j958). No kernel supplies expected values. Changes are listed in canonical target-key order.
